answer: Give every identity a sealed, private endowment each epoch — differing copper lots and needs it may only whisper about in negotiation. To earn standing in the haven market it must trade with strangers at publicly settled prices. One operator's fakes already know each other's hidden reservation prices, so they settle instantly at exact values no stranger could guess, with no haggling loss. Auditors score that impossible knowledge: repeated perfect-price trades mark common control and those identities lose standing, while honest traders show noisy, lossy price discovery.
